layout.title: Veerify - Feedback, roadmap and inbox in one place
layout.description: Veerify is the open-source workspace for product teams: feedback boards, voting, public roadmaps, changelogs, and a shared inbox for email on your own domain.
layout.ogDescription: Collect feedback, publish your roadmap and changelog, and answer customers from a shared inbox on your own domain.

hero.betaPill: New: shared inbox and email on your domain
hero.subtext: Veerify brings feedback, roadmap, changelog and a shared inbox for your email into one open-source workspace - so you always know what to build next, and who is waiting for it.

0.question: What is Veerify?
0.answer: Veerify is an open-source tool for product teams. It combines public feedback boards with voting, a public roadmap, a changelog and a shared inbox for customer email, so feature requests and support conversations live in one place.

1.question: Is Veerify free?
1.answer: Yes, while Veerify is in open beta. That includes unlimited projects and team members. Paid plans will come after the beta, and we will announce prices well before anything changes.

2.question: Is Veerify open source? Can I self-host it?
2.answer: Yes. The code is on GitHub under AGPL-3.0. You can run it yourself with Docker, PostgreSQL and S3-compatible storage, or use the hosted version at app.veerify.io.

3.question: Can I use email addresses on my own domain?
3.answer: Yes. Connect any domain, add the DNS records Veerify shows you, and create addresses like support@ or hello@, plus a catch-all. Each address can deliver to the inbox, forward to someone, or both. Use a subdomain if you want to keep your current mail provider.

4.question: Can Veerify replace Canny?
4.answer: For most teams, yes. Veerify has feedback boards, voting, a public roadmap and a changelog. You can import posts, comments, votes and changelog entries from Canny through the MCP server, with a preview before anything is written. Canny has more third-party integrations.

5.question: Does Veerify replace a help desk?
5.answer: For small teams that handle support over email, often it does. The inbox has assignment, snooze, canned responses, SLAs, auto-replies and satisfaction surveys. There is no live chat or knowledge base yet.

6.question: Can AI agents work with Veerify?
6.answer: Yes. Veerify has an MCP server. Connect Claude Code or another MCP client with a personal API key, and the agent can do what you can do in the dashboard, with your permissions and nothing more.
